summary: Relentless Energy Systems LLC submits technical evidence and circuit netlists for Geometric Phase Isolation, a passive resonant device it says offloads reactive power at the point of load, as a grid enhancing technology for large-load interconnection.
ask: Have Commission engineering staff review the Geometric Phase Isolation evidence as a grid enhancing technology applicable to large-load interconnection constraints.

points.point: Relentless submits solver-verified models of Geometric Phase Isolation as a grid enhancing technology tied to the show cause orders.
points.quote: technical evidence and Xyce netlists and results to assist regional transmission organizations and the Commission in mitigating the infrastructure impacts of large loads

points.point: The company says the device offloads reactive power at the load and increases interconnection capacity without new rights-of-way.
points.quote: materially increases available interconnection capacity without requiring new transmission rights‑of‑way.

points.point: The submission lists three document groups: netlist sweeps, a resilient-resonance netlist, and a non-provisional patent application.
points.quote: The following three (3) groups of documents are included in this public eFiling for technical review by Commission engineering staff

throughLine.text: Filed across the show cause dockets as a grid enhancing technology; it bears on the E-7 directive to evaluate alternative transmission technologies in transmission service studies.
